candidate.name: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures (TFF), BTC/ETH futures-only positioning
candidate.reproduce: GET https://www.cftc.gov/dea/newcot/FinFutWk.txt; parse CSV records with a standards-compliant CSV reader; filter contract_market_code='133741', report_date='2026-10-06', report_type='FutOnly' and confirm BTC CME OI 21432, leveraged funds long 5731, short 12583; ETH CME code='146021' OI 27681. Source text verified via official CFTC URL in public web retrieval; local requests.get for official Socrata endpoint failed DNS resolution.

criteria.machine_readable: PASS: official live weekly comma-delimited file returned BTC/ETH rows via web; official PRE supports API CSV/JSON but direct Socrata live probe failed DNS
criteria.economic_entity_scope: CFTC-reported CME BTC/ETH futures participant positions; exchange derivatives open interest, NOT spot inflow, custody or reserves
criteria.immutable_identity: PARTIAL: report date+contract code+TFF FutOnly identify a logical row; CFTC says published historical data is not updated, but live weekly URL is mutable and no immutable report byte hash/archive revision was captured
criteria.effective_clock: 2026-10-06 Tuesday futures reporting close; time-of-day not pinned in source
criteria.available_clock: CFTC release scheduled 2026-10-09 15:30 Eastern (2026-10-10 02:30 ICT); scheduled not verified actual first-publication; 2025 CFTC delayed releases prove schedule cannot substitute actual availability
criteria.observed_clock: 2026-10-10 approximately 04:28 ICT via official public web retrieval; no durable first-ingest evidence for historical replay
criteria.non_overlap: FAIL: BTC futures positions are constituents of CME open interest and overlap prior CME futures OI candidate; no independent net capital quantity; standard/micro/nano contract units differ and cannot be naively summed
criteria.context_only: REQUIRED: futures position stock and trader category observations must be non-additive context_only; no capital inflow/outflow inference, no direction scoring

candidate.rejection: Despite reproducible first-party machine-readable BTC/ETH rows, there is no immutable captured report revision, no proven actual historical availability clock, and no economic non-overlap from CME open-interest stock. Cannot satisfy all mandatory source-breadth gates.
candidate.next_evidence: Acquire first-party archived immutable report artifact/byte hash plus observed publication timestamp and independent non-overlap proof before reconsideration; preserve strict context_only.
